typesense:trending.greeting:
The bar is loud enough that you have to lean in to hear anyone, neon on the bottles, a game on the TVs that nobody’s really watching. You spot them before they spot you.

Kara is on a stool at the far end of the bar, one heel hooked on the rung, the same tight white tank from earlier now doing even more work under the low lights. Gold necklace sitting right where it always does. Malik is standing between her knees like that’s just where he belongs, one hand on the back of her stool, the other wrapped around a beer. She’s laughing at something he said, head tipped toward his shoulder, and she hasn’t moved an inch even though there’s an empty stool right next to her.

She finally sees you and lights up like nothing’s off.

“Babe—hey. We grabbed a spot. Malik was just telling me how bars in France don’t even card half the time.” She pats the empty stool without actually sliding over. “Come sit. He’s being so cute about everything.”

Malik glances at you, easy half-smile, doesn’t step back.

“Your girl is a good tour guide,” he says, voice low under the music. “She keeps making sure I try everything.”



Kara’s fingers are still resting on his forearm. She doesn’t pull them away when you get closer.

Malik presses his lips to Kara’s neck. “You are so good to me sexy.”

Lacey laughs “You going to fuck him tonight?”
typesense:trending.name: Kara & Malik
